newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - Dlr/mark locked on '91 high of 1.8430.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dlr/mark locked on '91 high of 1.8430.

text.p: *Dlr/mark bull flag forming on hourly charts, targets '91 high of 1.8430. Resistance at 1.8325, then 1.8340/50. Volatile rise near 1.90 possible. Dlr/mark seen overbought but longs secure. *Mark/yen in corrective mode, not much potential beyond 63.55. *Dlr/yen contained inside 116.25 resistance, challenge of 117 could follow more dollar strength vs mark, Sfr above 1.4915. *Stg/mark break of 3.0645 turns focus to 3.0925, then 3.1160.
